integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from Clarkson and Hanner inequalities plus explicit Birkhoff--James witnesses. No finite computation is used as an infinite proof. The sequence-space special case is treated as already covered by a published generalized-James result; the accepted claim is the measure-space \(L^p\) theorem.
scientific_limitations: Requires two disjoint measurable sets of finite positive measure; does not classify all maximizers or extend beyond exact \(L^p\) geometry. The focal preprint's full text was inaccessible during comparison, leaving a stated residual originality risk.
title: Exact weighted Birkhoff–James constant on real \(L^p\) spaces
